title: The Moth on the Warm Wall
youtube_title: The Moth on the Warm Wall | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Tala finds a moth resting on the warm wall by the lamp, not the lamp itself. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Tala shows Dae how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
